# E093 -- LA Lakers Design and Brand Guidelines

## Metadata
- **Brand**: Los Angeles Lakers
- **Industry**: Sports / NBA
- **Year**: June 2018 (v1.0)
- **Source file**: `639550d574bc483eb030a12565590051.pdf`

- **Format**: US Letter (612x792)

## Brand Strategy
- **Mission statement**: "The Los Angeles Lakers is a family-based sports and entertainment organization devoted to loyalty, winning, and delivering a fan-facing experience across the globe."
- **Core values**: Integrity, United, Service, Inspire (with connecting words: "WITH integrity, ALWAYS united, IN service, TO inspire").

## Logo
- **Logo set**: Primary logo, secondary logo, stacked wordmark, horizontal wordmark, uniform wordmark, city wordmark.
- **Secondary "L" logo**: debuted 2002-03 season, updated "L" with streaking lines, communicates timeless values in modern mark.
- **12 specific incorrect usage rules** for primary logo: no stretch/distort, no color alteration, no 3D effects, no inverted colors, no rotation, no color change on outline, no drop shadows, no added elements, no covering, no skewing, no additional strokes, no outline removal.
- Extensive logo coverage: Lakers logos (pages 14-33), Lakers wordmarks (pages 34-57), pattern (page 58), South Bay Lakers logos (pages 64-83), South Bay Lakers wordmarks (pages 84-99).
- Additional venue/facility logos: UCLA Health Training Center logo, Staples Center logo.

## Typography
- **Primary typeface**: DIN Next Font Family (headlines and body copy).
  - Weights: Light, Regular, Medium, Bold, Heavy, Condensed, Bold Condensed, Heavy Condensed.
  - Headline typefaces: uppercase, tracking 25.
  - Body copy typefaces: tracking 25.
- **Uniform typeface**: NBA Lakers (dedicated jersey font).
- **Fallback**: Arial/Helvetica for emails and contexts where DIN Next is unavailable.

## Color
- **Lakers color palette** (introduced 1967 by Jack Kent Cooke):
  - Lakers Purple: PMS 268, CMYK 79/100/0/12, RGB 85/37/130, HEX #552583
  - Lakers Gold: PMS 123, CMYK 0/30/94/0, RGB 253/185/39, HEX #FDB927
  - Black: PMS Black, CMYK 30/100/0/0, RGB 6/25/34, HEX #000000
- One-color reproduction rules: white and gray options acceptable with sufficient contrast.
- South Bay Lakers have a separate color palette (page 62+).

## Outliers
- **Multi-entity brand system**: covers main Lakers, South Bay Lakers (G League affiliate), UCLA Health Training Center, and Staples Center all in one document -- comprehensive sports franchise brand architecture.
- Heavy logo/wordmark focus: ~90 pages of the 64-page document devoted to logo and wordmark variations across all entities.

## Quality Score
3/5 -- Solid sports franchise brand guide with strong logo governance, comprehensive multi-entity coverage, and precise color specifications. Lacks tone of voice, limited photography guidance, and no graphic system beyond pattern. Primarily a logo/wordmark reference document rather than a holistic brand guide.
